description: This file is a Perl script that acts as a wrapper for invoking the MSVC 'lib.exe' utility in a Windows environment, specifically designed to facilitate building Git with MSVC using GNU Make. It modifies command-line arguments to handle certain flags and file types before executing the external tool.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main script logic, handling argument processing and executing the external 'lib.exe' command.
